title: Work event PR metadata linkage
intent: Preparing a live GUI so the Linked Work PR link can be visually verified before PR #4186 is updated
progress_summary: Fast-forwarded onto origin/work/issue-3697 (AC-1..AC-6 already landed there). Found that the previous session's AC-7 commit ae779ae2e never reached origin, so AC-7 was re-implemented. Linked Work now renders the PR through the shared createWorkspacePrMeta renderer, so it links to pr_url instead of printing plain text; appendDefinitionList accepts node-valued rows and the duplicate PR state row is dropped when the renderer runs. Separately, the one red CI job (Test (Rust default parallelism, Windows), 3 failures in cli::pr::tests::pr_metadata_current_rejects_*) was a fixture path-spelling bug: the fixture seeded project_root from std::fs::canonicalize (Windows verbatim form) while the producer writes back the form returned by resolve_current_worktree_root; the fixture now uses the same production resolver, keeping the whole-struct assert intact. Verified: cargo fmt clean, clippy -p gwt --all-targets --all-features clean, cli::pr 42/42, frontend unit 1366/1373 (7 pre-existing Windows-host ESM path failures in provider-usage-surface.test.mjs), frontend smoke 30/30, Playwright quiet-work-ui-e2e 18/18 and kanban + workspace-remote-branch-rows 40/40 in both dark and light. RED proven for both new tests by reverting the surface change. Committed as 941058be4 and 682715ff5 and pushed.
